text:
The 2024–2025 ToI / Origin Law / ε* material is correctly marked not-claimed. It used to be easy to miss and easy to leak into search. This shelf is the reading list / superseded voice: dates, a one-line reason it is not current, and a link to the article that keeps the equations.

A reviewer can still see the trail. Search will show the not-claimed badge in the snippet so a 2025 sentence cannot surface as if it were a 2026 theorem.

Where the equations live
